title: Amazon Textract Insights Makes AI Document Extraction Verifiable
dek: AWS's new AI pulls data from messy files and shows exactly where it came from.

facts.label: Pages per file in one packet
AWS Regions now running Textract Core

caption:
What if your AI could prove where every number came from? 📄

Amazon Web Services just made Amazon Textract Insights generally available. Describe the fields you want in plain English, upload a document or a messy packet of up to 3,000 pages, and get structured data back. Every value comes with a confidence score and the exact page and spot it was pulled from.

That matters for banks, insurers, healthcare groups and government agencies, where auditors need answers they can check. Textract Insights splits mixed files like mortgage applications into separate documents, matches each to a blueprint and extracts the fields in one API call, with no model training and per-page pricing.

post_caption:
Fluent answers aren't enough when an auditor asks where a figure came from. Amazon Textract Insights returns every extracted value with a confidence score and a pointer to its source page.

It handles W-2s, tax returns, passports and mixed document packets using plain-language blueprints, now generally available on AWS ✅
